title: A roomier Excalidraw toolbar
summary: The toolbar buttons were cramped: small targets, dead gaps between them, and no clear groups. The Spaced toolbar gives every control a 44px target, sorts the tools into five groups, and shows a bold focus ring when you use the keyboard.

variations.name: Spaced
variations.idea: 44px targets with no dead gaps, tools in clearly spaced groups, and a bold keyboard focus ring.
variations.why: Every tool is easier to hit and the groups are quick to scan. It still fits in one row on a laptop, and it slims down to fit on a tablet.

pr.title: Make the Spaced toolbar the default
